notice:
App logos

The logo files below are copied from dashboard-icons
(https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons) at commit
d767d7327db7f8ebd3715b552523f61889eea41c, under the Apache License,
Version 2.0. The full license text is LICENSE.dashboard-icons.

  Copyright (c) 2024 Bjorn Lammers, Meier Lukas, Thomas Camlong and Homarr Labs

The logos and product names are trademarks of their owners. They are shown
only to identify each app in the template catalog; showing them does not
mean the owners endorse this project.

SVG files are unchanged copies of the upstream svg/<name>.svg. WebP files are
the upstream png/<name>.png resized to 128 px and saved as WebP (the upstream
SVG is missing or embeds a large PNG). Apps the set has no usable logo for
(Appsmith, Redis Insight) keep their letter tile.

Template logos, served by the panel at /api/templates/<slug>/logo.<ext>:

  templates/code-server/logo.webp     png/code-server.png (resized)
  templates/directus/logo.svg         svg/directus.svg
  templates/excalidraw/logo.svg       svg/excalidraw.svg
  templates/filebrowser/logo.svg      svg/filebrowser.svg
  templates/ghost/logo.webp           png/ghost.png (resized)
  templates/gitea/logo.svg            svg/gitea.svg
  templates/grafana/logo.svg          svg/grafana.svg
  templates/it-tools/logo.svg         svg/it-tools.svg
  templates/listmonk/logo.svg         svg/listmonk.svg
  templates/mattermost/logo.svg       svg/mattermost.svg
  templates/meilisearch/logo.svg      svg/meilisearch.svg
  templates/metabase/logo.svg         svg/metabase.svg
  templates/n8n/logo.svg              svg/n8n.svg
  templates/nocodb/logo.svg           svg/nocodb.svg
  templates/pgadmin/logo.svg          svg/pgadmin.svg
  templates/plausible/logo.svg        svg/plausible.svg
  templates/prometheus/logo.svg       svg/prometheus.svg
  templates/stirling-pdf/logo.svg     svg/stirling-pdf.svg
  templates/umami/logo.svg            svg/umami.svg
  templates/uptime-kuma/logo.svg      svg/uptime-kuma.svg
  templates/vaultwarden/logo.svg      svg/vaultwarden.svg

To add or update one: take the file from the same repository at a pinned
commit (raw.githubusercontent.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/<commit>/...),
keep an SVG under 50 KB and a raster under 30 KB, list it here and update the
commit above. A logo from somewhere else gets its own line with its source
and license.

templates.description: Build internal tools, admin panels and dashboards on your APIs and databases.

meta.yaml.text:
name: "Appsmith"
description: "Build internal tools, admin panels and dashboards on your APIs and databases."
category: "Developer tools"
tags: ["low-code", "internal-tools"]
creates: "App"
links:
  - label: "Website"
    url: "https://www.appsmith.com"
  - label: "Docs"
    url: "https://docs.appsmith.com"
body: |
  Appsmith runs everything it needs in one container and keeps its data in the `stacks` volume. It needs about 2 GB of memory.
schema:
  type: object
  required: ["image"]
  properties:
    image:
      type: "string"
      title: "Image"
      description: "Docker image and tag to run."
      default: "appsmith/appsmith-ce:v1.55"

templates.name: Appsmith

templates.description: Virtual whiteboard for hand-drawn style sketches and diagrams.

meta.yaml.text:
name: "Excalidraw"
description: "Virtual whiteboard for hand-drawn style sketches and diagrams."
category: "Productivity"
tags: ["whiteboard", "diagrams", "drawing"]
creates: "App"
links:
  - label: "Website"
    url: "https://excalidraw.com"
  - label: "Repository"
    url: "https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw"
body: |
  A static Excalidraw app. Drawings stay in each browser unless you export or share them. The project only publishes the `latest` tag, so the image is pinned to the digest that tag had on 14 Nov 2026; put a newer digest here to update.
schema:
  type: object
  required: ["image"]
  properties:
    image:
      type: "string"
      title: "Image"
      description: "Docker image and tag (or digest) to run."
      default: "excalidraw/excalidraw:latest@sha256:f7ee194addd607bf831d2af0f0a34463dd4225e426cf35199ef0b12a803398e9"

templates.name: Excalidraw

  - label: "Website"
    url: "https://plausible.io"
  - label: "Self-hosting guide"
    url: "https://github.com/plausible/community-edition"
body: |
  Plausible Community Edition keeps accounts in Postgres and events in ClickHouse.
  The app runs its migrations on every start. Register the first account after the first deploy;
  set `DISABLE_REGISTRATION` in its environment afterwards if you want to close sign-ups.

  type: object
  required: ["image", "clickhouseImage"]
  properties:
    image:
      type: "string"
      title: "Image"
      description: "Docker image and tag to run."
      default: "ghcr.io/plausible/community-edition:v2.1.4"
    clickhouseImage:
      type: "string"
      title: "ClickHouse image"
      default: "clickhouse/clickhouse-server:24.3.3.102-alpine"

templates.description: Metrics collection and alerting with a powerful query language.

name: "Prometheus"
description: "Metrics collection and alerting with a powerful query language."
category: "Monitoring"
tags: ["metrics", "monitoring"]
creates: "App"
links:
  - label: "Website"
    url: "https://prometheus.io"
  - label: "Docs"
    url: "https://prometheus.io/docs"
body: |
  Prometheus starts with a configuration that scrapes itself. Edit `/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml`
  (a file mount on the Storage tab) to add your targets, then redeploy.
  The domain has no login: keep it private with basic auth or an IP allow list on the domain.
schema:
  type: object
  required: ["image"]
  properties:
    image:
      type: "string"
      title: "Image"
      description: "Docker image and tag to run."
      default: "prom/prometheus:v3.1.0"
    retention:
      type: "string"
      title: "Keep data for"
      description: "For example 15d or 90d."
      default: "15d"

templates.description: Lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password manager server.

meta.yaml.text:
name: "Vaultwarden"
description: "Lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password manager server."
category: "Security"
tags: ["passwords", "security", "bitwarden"]
creates: "App"
links:
  - label: "Repository"
    url: "https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden"
  - label: "Wiki"
    url: "https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/wiki"
body: |
  Use any Bitwarden client with the domain as the server URL. The admin page is at `/admin` with the admin token. Turn sign-ups off once your accounts exist.
schema:
  type: object
  required: ["image"]
  properties:
    image:
      type: "string"
      title: "Image"
      description: "Docker image and tag to run."
      default: "vaultwarden/server:1.32.7"
    adminToken:
      type: "string"
      format: "password"
      title: "Admin token"
      description: "Opens /admin. Generated when left empty."
    signups:
      type: "boolean"
      title: "Allow sign-ups"
      default: true
